data.name: Estevan
data.gender_notes: Estevan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Esteban, meaning ‘crown, garland, wreath’. In the Bible, Esteban was a name given to Stephen, a deacon in the early Christian church. He was the first Christian martyr and was stoned to death. The name Estevan carries the meaning “Crown, Garland, Wreath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Estevan usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, garland, wreath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and the power to overcome adversity. In Christian tradition, Estevan represents the martyrs who sacrificed their lives for their faith.
data.etymology: Estevan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crown, Garland, Wreath.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Estevan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אסטבן
in_hebrew.meaning: עטרת ה' היא קrown ה' הוא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אסטבן הוא שם שמשמעותו 'עטרת ה'' או 'קrown ה'', ומקורו בשם היווני 'סטפנוס' (Στεφανός), שפירושו 'עטרה' או 'זר'. השם אסטבן קשור לשם סטפנוס, אחד משבעה הדיאקונים הראשונים של הכנסייה הנוצרית, שנהרג על אמונתו בישו. השם משקף את חשיבות האמונה והקורבן עבור המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Εστεβάν
in_greek.meaning: Το στεφάνι του Θεού εἰς τὴν δόξαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Εστεβάν σημαίνει 'το στεφάνι του Θεού' ἤ 'ἡ κορόνη τοῦ Θεοῦ', καὶ εἶναι ἡ μετάφρασις τοῦ ονόματος Στεφανός (Στεφανός), τό ὁποῖον σημαίνει 'στεφάνι' ἤ 'ζωστήρ'. Ὁ Στεφανός ἦταν ἕνας τῶν πρώτων επτά διακόνων τῆς Χριστιανικῆς Ἐκκλησίας, ὁ ὁποῖος μαρτύρησεν διὰ τὴν πίστην αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν. Τό ὄνομα Εστεβάν ἀπεικονίζει τὴν σημασία τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς θυσίας διὰ τοὺς πιστούς.

in_latin.name: Estevan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Estevan significat 'corona Dei' vel 'honor Dei', et derivatur ex nomine Graeco Στεφανός (Stephanus), quod significat 'corona' vel 'zona'. Stephanus fuit unus ex primis septem diaconis Ecclesiae Christianae, qui propter fidem suam in Iesum Christum martyrizatus est. Nomen Estevan reflectit momentum fidei et sacrificii pro fidelibus.

in_english.name: Estevan
in_english.meaning: Crown, wreath, or garland of God
in_english.long_meaning: Estevan is a Christian name that means 'crown, wreath, or garland of God'. It is derived from the Greek name Στεφανός (Stephanus), which means 'crown' or 'wreath'. The name is associated with Saint Stephen, one of the first seven deacons of the Christian Church, who was martyred for his faith in Jesus Christ. Estevan symbolizes the importance of faith and sacrifice for believers, and it is often given to boys born into Christian families. The name reflects the values of devotion, loyalty, and spiritual commitment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Estevan carries a rich cultural heritage, being derived from the name Esteban, a popular Hispanic name. It has strong associations with the Christian religion due to its use in the Bible for Saint Stephen, the first Christian martyr.
data.spiritual_significance: Named after Saint Stephen, Estevan holds a deep spiritual significance. His life embodies the value of unwavering faith and devotion in the face of persecution. The name is a reminder of the ultimate sacrifice made by Saint Stephen for his beliefs and the impact it had on the early Christian community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Estevan, meaning "crown" in Hebrew, symbolizes the crown of thorns worn by Jesus Christ during His Passion, emphasizing the sacrifice and royalty in surrendering to God's will.

biblical_reference.note: The name Estevan is associated with Saint Stephen, a disciple of Jesus and one of the first deacons of the Christian Church, who was stoned to death for his faith (Acts 7:54-60).

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Estevan was a 16th-century explorer from Portugal. The name Estevan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Estevan was the first European to explore the lands of present-day California.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Estevan remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
